items.title: 27.5.3 Jeneyati code aur protein ki tayyari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the genetic code and protein synthesis with Quick Check 27.4 answered (PDF 174).

blocks.text: Protein synthesis (protein banna) aik pecheeda amal hai jis mein DNA mein code ki hui genetic maloomat aage muntaqil hoti hai. Jaandaron mein bohat se proteins banane ke liye do amal zaroori hain: transcription aur translation. Amal replication se shuru hota hai, yani nucleus mein DNA ki copies banti hain. Phir protein banane ki genetic hidayaat DNA ke gene se mRNA mein copy hoti hain; is amal ko transcription kehte hain. Jab mRNA ka dhaaga mukammal ho jaye to woh DNA se alag ho kar cytoplasm mein chala jata hai aur ribosomes se jur jata hai. Ribosomes par mRNA ka code parha jata hai aur amino acids ki aik khaas tarteeb mein badla jata hai; is tarah protein banne ke amal ko translation kehte hain. Amino acids RNA ke bases ki tarteeb ke mutabiq lagte hain. tRNA molecules apne amino acids chhorte hain jo aapas mein jur kar zanjeer, yani polypeptide chain, banate hain. Amino acids ke darmiyan bonds bante jate hain, zanjeer lambi hoti jati hai, aur aakhir mein poora protein molecule ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar se neeche: DNA se wapas DNA tak ghoomta teer, replication (DNA se DNA), DNA polymerase; DNA (do dhaage); teer transcription (DNA se RNA), RNA polymerase; RNA (aik dhaaga); teer translation (RNA se protein), ribosome; aur motiyon ki lari ki shakal mein protein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Replication ka ghoomta teer DNA se wapas DNA par aata hai: DNA ki naqal. Transcription nucleus mein DNA se RNA banati hai, aur translation cytoplasm mein ribosomes par RNA ke code se amino acids ki lari (protein) banati hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Sugar-phosphate backbone aur dono zanjeeron ke darmiyan base pairing se milne wali mazbooti ka muqabla karein. Bonds ki qism aur Adenine (A)–Thymine (T) aur Guanine (G)–Cytosine (C) ke darmiyan bonds ki tadaad batayein.
blocks.explanation: Backbone mazboot covalent phosphodiester bonds se jura hai, is liye har dhaaga bohat mazboot hai. Dono dhaage sirf bases ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds se jure hain: A–T jore mein do aur G–C jore mein teen. Har hydrogen bond kamzor hai, is liye dhaage replication ke liye alag ho sakte hain, lekin lakhon bonds mil kar double helix ko mazbooti se thaamte hain; G–C zyada hon to hissa zyada mazboot hota hai.

blocks.prompt: b) DNA aur RNA chemically kaise mukhtalif hain? Dono mein kya baatein milti hain?
blocks.explanation: Farq: DNA mein deoxyribose sugar aur thymine hai aur yeh do dhaagon wala hai; RNA mein ribose aur uracil hai aur yeh aam taur par aik dhaage wala hai. Mushabehat: dono nucleotides (phosphate, paanch carbon sugar, base) ke polymers hain jo phosphodiester links se jure hain, aur dono mein A, G aur C bases hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Insani jism ke taqreeban har cell mein bilkul wahi 23 jore chromosomes hain, phir bhi laal khoon ka cell haemoglobin banata hai aur jild ka cell keratin. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Har qism ka cell mukhtalif genes chalu karta hai: banne wala laal khoon ka cell haemoglobin ka gene transcribe karta hai, aur jild ka cell keratin ka gene; baqi genes band rehte hain.

items: Replication: DNA ki naqal; transcription: nucleus mein DNA se mRNA.
Translation: ribosomes par mRNA ka code parh kar tRNA amino acids ko protein mein jorte hain.
